intent: Name what is missing in a short headline.
typical_uses: The one-line headline of an Empty, such as "No results"

dont_use_when.situation: The title of a card that holds real content

invariants.text: EmptyTitle renders a div with no heading role or level, so it does not appear in the page's heading outline.

anti_patterns.do_instead: Keep EmptyTitle to the short headline and give the explanation its own EmptyDescription beneath it

bad.title: The explanation folded into the headline
bad.code:
<EmptyHeader>
  <EmptyTitle>No results. Try a different search term or clear your filters.</EmptyTitle>
</EmptyHeader>
bad.why: EmptyTitle is the headline; the explanation belongs in EmptyDescription, which carries the muted body text.
